title: Still Ours? — Cross-Linguistic LLM Code-Painting Instrument and Worldview Archive
description: Open-source projective code-painting instrument (p5.js 1.11.13; MIT License) and compact cross-linguistic worldview tables (CC BY 4.0) probing nine frontier AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Mistral) across English, Chinese, and French. Covers Chapter I: Death (270 canonical calls, 269 counted paintings, Bitcoin block #974,473) and Chapter II: Love (270 canonical calls, 266 statements, 263 paintings, Bitcoin block #975,705). Full-resolution 1600x2000 PNGs and raw response bundles are archived separately as a companion Zenodo deposit.
